NKJV.1: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
NKJV.2: And Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar ministered as priests.
NKJV.3: Then David with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to the schedule of their service.
NKJV.4: There were more leaders found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar, and thus they were divided. Among the sons of Eleazar were sixteen heads of their fathers’ houses, and eight heads of their fathers’ houses among the sons of Ithamar.
NKJV.5: Thus they were divided by lot, one group as another, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials of the house of God, from the sons of Eleazar and from the sons of Ithamar.
NKJV.6: And the scribe, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel, one of the Levites, wrote them down before the king, the leaders, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and Levites, one father’s house taken for Eleazar and one for Ithamar.
NKJV.7: Now the first lot fell to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
NKJV.8: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
NKJV.9: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
NKJV.10: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
NKJV.11: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
NKJV.12: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
NKJV.13: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
NKJV.14: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
NKJV.15: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
NKJV.16: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
NKJV.17: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
NKJV.18: the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
NKJV.19: This was the schedule of their service for coming into the house of the LORD according to their ordinance by the hand of Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
NKJV.20: And the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
NKJV.21: Concerning Rehabiah, of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
NKJV.22: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
NKJV.23: Of the sons of Hebron, Jeriah was the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
NKJV.24: Of the sons of Uzziel, Michah; of the sons of Michah, Shamir.
NKJV.25: The brother of Michah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
NKJV.26: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi; the son of Jaaziah, Beno.
NKJV.27: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
NKJV.28: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
NKJV.29: Of Kish: the son of Kish, Jerahmeel.
NKJV.30: Also the sons of Mushi were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
NKJV.31: These also cast lots just as their brothers the sons of Aaron did, in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ houses of the priests and Levites. The chief fathers did just as their younger brethren.

NASB.1: Now the divisions of the descendants of Aaron [were these]: the sons of Aaron [were] Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
NASB.2: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons. So Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
NASB.3: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their offices for their ministry.
NASB.4: Since more chief men were found from the descendants of Eleazar than the descendants of Ithamar, they divided them thus: [there were] sixteen heads of fathers' households of the descendants of Eleazar and eight of the descendants of Ithamar, according to their fathers' households.
NASB.5: Thus they were divided by lot, the one as the other; for they were officers of the sanctuary and officers of God, both from the descendants of Eleazar and the descendants of Ithamar.
NASB.6: Shemaiah, the son of Nethanel the scribe, from the Levites, recorded them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers' [households] of the priests and of the Levites; one father's household taken for Eleazar and one taken for Ithamar.
NASB.7: Now the first lot came out for Jehoiarib, the second for Jedaiah,
NASB.8: the third for Harim, the fourth for Seorim,
NASB.9: the fifth for Malchijah, the sixth for Mijamin,
NASB.10: the seventh for Hakkoz, the eighth for Abijah,
NASB.11: the ninth for Jeshua, the tenth for Shecaniah,
NASB.12: the eleventh for Eliashib, the twelfth for Jakim,
NASB.13: the thirteenth for Huppah, the fourteenth for Jeshebeab,
NASB.14: the fifteenth for Bilgah, the sixteenth for Immer,
NASB.15: the seventeenth for Hezir, the eighteenth for Happizzez,
NASB.16: the nineteenth for Pethahiah, the twentieth for Jehezkel,
NASB.17: the twenty-first for Jachin, the twenty-second for Gamul,
NASB.18: the twenty-third for Delaiah, the twenty-fourth for Maaziah.
NASB.19: These were their offices for their ministry when [they] came in to the house of the LORD according to the ordinance [given] to them through Aaron their father, just as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
NASB.20: Now for the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
NASB.21: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the first.
NASB.22: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
NASB.23: The sons [of Hebron]: Jeriah [the first], Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
NASB.24: [Of] the sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
NASB.25: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
NASB.26: The sons of Merari, Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, Beno.
NASB.27: The sons of Merari: by Jaaziah [were] Beno, Shoham, Zaccur and Ibri.
NASB.28: By Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
NASB.29: By Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.
NASB.30: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth. These [were] the sons of the Levites according to their fathers' households.
NASB.31: These also cast lots just as their relatives the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers' [households] of the priests and of the Levites-- the head of fathers' [households] as well as those of his younger brother.

ESV.9: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

NLT.1: This is how Aaron’s descendants, the priests, were divided into groups for service. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
NLT.2: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and they had no sons. So only Eleazar and Ithamar were left to carry on as priests.
NLT.3: With the help of Zadok, who was a descendant of Eleazar, and of Ahimelech, who was a descendant of Ithamar, David divided Aaron’s descendants into groups according to their various duties.
NLT.4: Eleazar’s descendants were divided into sixteen groups and Ithamar’s into eight, for there were more family leaders among the descendants of Eleazar.
NLT.5: All tasks were assigned to the various groups by means of sacred lots so that no preference would be shown, for there were many qualified officials serving God in the sanctuary from among the descendants of both Eleazar and Ithamar.
NLT.6: Shemaiah son of Nethanel, a Levite, acted as secretary and wrote down the names and assignments in the presence of the king, the officials, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites. The descendants of Eleazar and Ithamar took turns casting lots.

AMP.1: The divisions of the descendants of Aaron were these: the sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
AMP.2: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
AMP.3: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their offices for their assigned duties.
AMP.4: Since there were more chief men found among the descendants of Eleazar than among the descendants of Ithamar [because of Eli's misfortunes, and Saul's massacre of the priests at Nob], they were divided in this way: sixteen heads of fathers' households of the descendants of Eleazar and eight of the descendants of Ithamar, corresponding to their fathers' households.
AMP.5: So they were divided by lot, one group with the other; for they were officers of the sanctuary and officers (high priests) of God, both from the descendants of Eleazar and from the descendants of Ithamar.
AMP.6: Shemaiah, the son of Nethanel the scribe, from the Levites, recorded them in the presence of the king, the officers, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar [the priest who escaped Saul's massacre at Nob], and the heads of the fathers' households of the priests and of the Levites; one father's household taken for Eleazar and one taken for Ithamar.

AMP.8: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
AMP.9: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
AMP.10: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
AMP.11: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
AMP.12: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
AMP.13: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
AMP.14: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
AMP.15: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,
AMP.16: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,
AMP.17: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,
AMP.18: the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.
AMP.19: These were their offices and positions for their service in the house of the LORD according to the ordinance given to them by their father (ancestor) Aaron, just as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.
AMP.20: Now as for the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram: Shubael; of the sons of Shubael: Jehdeiah.
AMP.21: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah: Isshiah the first.
AMP.22: Of the Izharites: Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

AMP.24: Of the sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
AMP.25: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
AMP.26: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah, Beno.
AMP.27: The sons of Merari: by Jaaziah were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.
AMP.28: By Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
AMP.29: By Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.
AMP.30: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites according to their fathers' households.
AMP.31: These also cast lots as did their relatives the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers' households of the priests and of the Levites—the head of father's households as well as those of his younger brother.
